projections_method_check.projection: Debt-to-GDP fork: consolidation -> 58.5% by 2035; stalled -> 73.7% by 2035 (breach by 2026)
projections_method_check.assessment: METHOD SOUND. Standard debt-dynamics recursion b_t = b_(t-1)(1+r)/(1+g) + primary deficit, r=4.2% (= debt service / debt stock). Independent corroboration: an analyst projection cited by FMT (24 Jul 2025) put debt at 65.8% by 2026 under a weak-growth scenario, consistent with the dossier's stalled path crossing the ceiling early. Labelled as T4A projection in the dossier, not as fact. NO CHANGE.
